description: Follow new or changed catalog entries. Defaults to newest first, or newest CISA KEV additions when kev is true. For incremental sync, pass modified_since with sort=modified. Use search for best matches to a text query.

ecosystem.description: Package ecosystem, such as npm, PyPI, Maven, Go or crates.io.

exploited.description: Only entries with reported exploitation (KEV, CISA SSVC, ENISA, VulnCheck KEV or Shadowserver honeypots).

fix_available.description: Only entries with a fixed version.

kev.description: Only entries in the CISA KEV catalog.

modified_since.description: Only entries whose merged record changed at or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD) or time (ISO 8601). Pass the newest modified value from the previous run.

package.description: Only entries naming this package, as ecosystem:name, such as npm:lodash or pypi:django.

product.description: Exact product name, such as log4j or exchange server.

public_exploit.description: Only entries with public exploit code.

query.description: Words to match against IDs, titles, vendors, products and descriptions.

since.description: Only entries published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

sort.description: Defaults to kev if kev is true, otherwise published.

tech.description: Only entries naming this vendor or vendor product, as a slug: apache, or apache/tomcat.

type.description: Filter to CVEs or advisories without a CVE.

until.description: Only entries published before this date (YYYY-MM-DD).

vendor.description: Exact vendor name, such as apache or microsoft.

wordpress.description: Only entries naming this WordPress software. Use plugin:contact-form-7, theme:astra or core.

name: list_feed

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same arguments, for the next page.

title: List recent vulnerabilities
